data_payload.identification_strategy: Two-stage sequential decoupling: Stage 1 fits normalized stress relaxation to identify viscoelastic spectrum parameters (c, tau1, tau2); Stage 2 fits the ramp phase to identify non-linear elastic constants (A, B) using the pre-identified relaxation parameters.

stage_1_relaxation_fit.objective_function: min SSR_relax = sum_{k=1}^{N_relax} ( sigma_norm_exp(t_k) - G(t_k; c, tau1, tau2) )^2

parameters.name: RelaxationStiffness
parameters.physical_meaning: Dimensionless viscous damping amplitude regulating the magnitude of continuous stress relaxation.

parameters.name: FastRelaxationTime
parameters.physical_meaning: Short-term relaxation time constant governing initial steep stress drop.

parameters.name: SlowRelaxationTime
parameters.physical_meaning: Long-term relaxation time constant governing transition to asymptotic equilibrium.

stage_1_relaxation_fit.physical_constraint: tau_1 < tau_2 (enforced via ValidateParameters delegate and barrier penalty)
stage_1_relaxation_fit.optimization_profile: CurveFitProfile.Automatic (routes to RuleConstrained / alglib.mindf GDEMO Differential Evolution due to active constraint)

stage_2_ramp_fit.objective_function: min SSR_ramp = sum_{j=1}^{N_ramp} ( sigma_exp(t_j) - sigma_calc(t_j, epsilon_j; A, B, c*, tau1*, tau2*) )^2
independent_variables: t' = t - t_0 (time points translated to origin)
stage_2_ramp_fit.theoretical_function: sigma_calc(t, epsilon; A, B) evaluated via IFungModelCalculator.CalculateStress incorporating Boltzmann hereditary convolution

ramp_hypotheses_evaluated.description: Ramp is treated as purely elastic (sigma = sigma^e) during loading (t <= t_0), with viscous relaxation acting over time elapsed after t_0.
Accounts for finite ramp duration by convoluting the ramp strain rate through the Boltzmann hereditary integral from t = 0.

stage_2_ramp_fit.optimization_profile: CurveFitProfile.Automatic (routes to Standard / alglib.minbleic L-BFGS with box bounds)

combined_evaluation_metrics.coefficient_of_determination_definition: R2 = 1 - (SSR / SST), where SSR = sum (y_k - f_k)^2 and SST = sum (y_k - y_mean)^2

software_architecture_mapping.numerical_solver: AlglibCurveFitter (ALGLIB minbleic L-BFGS and mindf GDEMO)

output_summary: Validated and fully documented Fung QLV 1D model objective function logic using inline lambdas in FungRelaxationOnlyCurveFitterStep.cs, adhering to the project's existing architectural standards. CHANGELOG.md was updated to reflect this validation.
justification_for_decisions: To strictly adhere to the 'Do Not Reinvent the Wheel' directive and maintain architectural consistency across the MelloSilveiraTools ecosystem, I avoided creating redundant custom ObjectiveFunction classes (which would have diverged from how models like Schapery are implemented). Instead, I mapped the Fung QLV 1D logic directly using the existing lambda architecture within the CurveFitterStep logic. This ensures a unified approach to curve-fitting constraints and mathematical abstraction across all mechanical models.
